summary: You love freely and easily. You can be close without clinging and give people room without losing the bond. Independence and affection flow together.
body: You love freely and easily. You can be close without clinging and give people room without losing the bond. Independence and affection flow together. You're drawn to the interesting and unconventional, and you make room for it without drama. Because it comes easy, the risk is keeping things so loose nothing deepens. The work is letting a free connection also go deep. Open and committed can be the same relationship.
gift: At your best: magnetic, generous with freedom, close without clinging.
shadow: The trap: keeping it so loose that nothing ever deepens.
integration: Let love and values and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Good for fresh, original creative and social moves; unreliable for steady commitments.
do: Let a free bond also go deep
Choose the interesting and stay for it
dont: Keep it loose to avoid depth
